topicTitle: Mechanics (optional): Dynamics — motion of particle in a straight line, motion with uniform acceleration, motion under gravity, motion down a smooth inclined plane
notes: **Fact.** 1st law (inertia): a body stays in uniform motion unless acted on by a net external force.
**Fact.** 2nd law: net force = rate of change of momentum = m·a (for constant m).
**Fact.** 3rd law: forces are mutual, equal and opposite, acting on different bodies (never cancel on the same body).
**Fact.** Impulse = ∫F dt = Δp; F = ma gives F = m·(Δv/Δt).
